visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and a dark striped tie, sits on a gray sofa. He points at the camera with an inquisitive expression. The background is a brightly lit indoor living room with a cream wall and a framed picture. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless top, appears in the frame. She gestures towards herself with a coy smile. Behind her is a plush light-colored blanket and a vinyl record decoration. (3) The man holds up a black smartphone toward the camera, displaying a digital photo of the woman appearing disheveled. He points at the screen while looking at her suspiciously. (4) The man reaches for a black shoulder bag sitting on the sofa next to the woman. She tries to stop him, creating a playful tug-of-war. The lighting is soft and consistent. (5) The man successfully pulls out a small, white, stick-shaped sachet from the bag. He holds it up with wide eyes and an open mouth in mock surprise. The woman holds her face in her hands, appearing playfully embarrassed. (6) The man opens the sachet and consumes its contents while leaning back dramatically. The camera angle shifts to a medium shot. (7) A dynamic montage follows where the man and woman dance in various locations, including the living room and a plain white studio background. They perform synchronized movements, pointing and gesturing to the camera. (8) Close-ups of the product packaging, a silver box and white sachets with text, are shown. The woman poses confidently with the box. (9) The video concludes with both characters standing back-to-back in the studio, then facing the camera with high-energy dance moves and finger guns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic electronic beat. A male voice speaks in a comedic, slightly confrontational tone, followed immediately by a higher-pitched, coy female response. A distinct plastic rustling sound occurs as the male character reaches for the bag. (2) As the man finds the sachet, a 'ding' sound effect triggers. He transition into a rhythmic rap/song, where the BPM is stable at roughly 110. The vocals are clear and processed with studio-grade reverb. (3) A 'whoosh' transition effect occurs as the scene changes. The BGM swells with a heavy synthesized bass line. Both male and female vocals overlap in a call-and-response pattern. (4) Percussive pops and stylized digital UI sound effects are peppered throughout the musical section, synchronized with visual transitions. (5) The song reaches a high-energy climax with layered vocal harmonies and high spectral brightness. The environmental floor remains silent, indicating a professional studio mix.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Discovery -> Musical Performance -> Branding
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative commercial designed to promote 'Better me' Sialic Acid Probiotics. It uses a comedic 'best friend' (閨蜜) scenario to create a relatable hook about a friend getting prettier in secret. This leads to the 'secret' product discovery, which triggers an upbeat musical performance that highlights the benefits of the product through lyrics. The high-energy editing and catchy song aim to build brand affinity and desirability among young consumers interested in beauty and wellness.
